Mexican Reggaeton.calibration_requirements: Measure actual separately rendered stem active level and peak; confirm exact original source mapping, musical role, kick audibility and subjective mix; never interpret proposals as universal published dB standards.

musical_definition.scope_note: 2026 Mexico City emerging scene baseline, not a definition of all Mexican reggaeton.
musical_definition.groove_behavior: reggaeton/dembow-derived pulse may combine with trap, plugg, jerk and alternative hip-hop components; component mix is explicit
musical_definition.phrase_behavior: short hook-oriented phrases with rap/vocal-like cadence and beat-switch possibilities
musical_definition.harmony_behavior: loop-based minor/modal/tonal harmony; harmonic simplicity may leave room for rhythm/texture
musical_definition.bass_behavior: sub/808-like or synth bass tied to kick/dembow pattern; slides optional by target
musical_definition.percussion_behavior_if_applicable: dembow-derived and trap/plugg/jerk-influenced electronic percussion may coexist by component map
musical_definition.instrument_role_behavior: electronic drums, sub/synth bass, synth/sample textures, voice/lead and optional guitar/alternative elements
musical_definition.ensemble_player_behavior: production components may change quickly between sections while preserving scene identity
musical_definition.dynamic_behavior: strong drops and hook lifts; dynamic contrast often production-driven
musical_definition.articulation_behavior: programmed transients, vocal-like lead articulation and sample chops
musical_definition.timing_humanization_behavior: grid-based with genre-component swing/jerk offsets when intentionally selected
musical_definition.sound_effects_intent: distortion, reverb, delay, clipping-style texture only as controlled production choices
musical_definition.mix_prominence_intent: sub/kick and lead/vocal-like role protected from masking
musical_definition.production_mastering_intent: modern loud but unclipped master with sub control
musical_definition.manufacturer_adapter_requirements: requires electronic drums/sub/synth resources; component provenance retained

Mexican Reggaeton.musical_development_policy: Build this genre's melody, harmony, bass, percussion, rhythm, form and expressive behaviors from its own definition and original sample links; no shared melody copying, no source edits, no blended stems.
